page.layout: One printed page of running text with brace diagrams set in the body; running head at top, page number at top centre, catchword "Gentes" at lower right, and two italic notes set below the text in full lines. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Huius autem {Mala. / Bona.} signa & praesagia sunt Mar.14..8.9.10.
main_text.p: Animā spectantia sunt pseudoprophetae & pseudochristi primū Christi aduentum fingentes, & sese pro Messia venditantes. Mat.24.5.6.11.12.
main_text.l: Mala corporis sunt infinitae illae {Communes. / In Bonos.} Marc. 14.8.
Communes sunt illae {Diuinae {Pestes. / Terrae motus in singulis locis.} Mat. 24.7.
Humanae, bella & Gentium conflictus; hinc autem rumores, turbae & fames. Mat.24.7.Mar.14.8.
main_text.p: In bonos sunt persecutiones acerrimae ad συνέ-δρια & συναγωγὰς Iudaeorum, etiam ex intimorum proditione, & multorum refrigerata charitate profectae. Mat.24.10.11.12.13.
Bonum autem vnicum est, vt euangelium regni in vniuersa terra, vt sit testimonio in omnibus gentibus praedicaretur. Mat.24.14.

p.i: Atqui hæc de Iudæorum ruina & signis adiunctis quæ omnia secundum Christi verbum 38. post ipsius mortem annis euenerunt.
Atqui hæc de Iudæis: Gentes sequuntur.

page.notes: The brace diagrams are transcribed as outline lines, their levels read from the drawing. The reference "Mar.14..8.9.10." and the Greek words are copied as printed. The small mark in the right margin and the show-through from the left page are not transcribed.
